purpose: Close the remaining V176 QPR mean deficit by retaining its exact count-two all-or-none guard and adding the smallest outcome-blind severe-backlog exception at count one: reject the lone heavy incomplete-parent terminal player only when the already-frozen current queue-density signal is at least four times the routing threshold.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.supported: V176 is the strongest candidate so far: it raises V170 throughput and QPR, passes the full throughput mean and paired gates, keeps 15 QPR paired wins, and misses only QPR mean by 0.00023900703328708084. Exact-two rejection is therefore beneficial but insufficient. In V176, lone heavy admissions occur under both ordinary and severe queues. Rejecting them unconditionally reproduces V168's throughput loss; rejecting them only during severe current backlog targets cost and congestion while retaining terminal progress in ordinary queues.
causal_diagnosis.threshold_rationale: 32 is exactly four times the frozen queue-routing threshold 8, not a fitted seed cutoff. It denotes severe backlog using the same current pending-plus-runnable tasks per node signal already used by the scheduler.

single_mechanism_change_from_v176.unchanged_primary_activation: activate exact V168 all-or-none CPU guard when current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player count is strictly greater than one
single_mechanism_change_from_v176.new_severe_backlog_activation: also activate when current heavy player count equals one and current operational queue density is at least 32
single_mechanism_change_from_v176.ordinary_count_one_behavior: retain exact V159 terminal admission when queue density is strictly below 32
single_mechanism_change_from_v176.active_rule: reject every current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player and admit no such heavy player

severe_backlog_definition.heavy_terminal_definition: terminal function, at least one incomplete direct parent, and immutable function.cpu divided by current cluster mean node CPU capacity strictly above one

mechanism_only_seed_selection.source: frozen V170 E01-E20 nash_metrics telemetry, without reading a V177 performance field
mechanism_only_seed_selection.ranking_rule: select every seed with at least one heavy-count-one window at queue density at least 32; execute the selected set in ascending seed order

frozen_hybrid_arithmetic_before_v177.unaffected_v176_reuse_basis: each has zero observed V176 heavy-count-one windows at queue density at least 32

checks: exact E06, E10, E11, E12, E15 and E18 product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
primary guard active for every heavy count above one exactly as V176
at heavy count exactly one the guard is active if and only if queue density is at least 32
at severe count-one activation the lone heavy player is rejected and no active heavy admission occurs
at ordinary count-one windows the guard is inactive and the lone heavy player is admitted exactly as V176/V159
every selected seed contains at least one severe count-one activation window
for every selected seed, assignment hashes before the first severe count-one window equal the frozen base sequence and the first divergence occurs at that first eligible window
parents-completed players bypass the terminal guard
nonterminal short-work counts and queue/work threshold invariants remain valid
both below-8 and at-or-above-8 placement routes occur across the fixed six
zero throughput, completion, latency, cost or QPR fields are parsed before audit sealing

diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_six_seed_paired_gate: at least two selected seeds beat paired OCS

diagnostic_selection_rule.full_qpr_gate: both QPR means strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697, at least 12 of 20 wins, and all finite
